citations.quote: Use duplicate_charge for a report of two charges for one purchase; retrieve both transaction records.
Routing precedence: manual_review for unsupported/ambiguous cases or unavailable transaction service;

Two things. First, Bramblewick Hardware charged me 437 credits and then charged it again, I can see both rows. Second, I never even wanted what they sold me, my cousin used my phone to order something and I have no idea if that was allowed. Either way I am not paying twice, and I also want to know if the original is something I should be paying at all.
